from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherNonCurrentAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """One data point for '其他非流动资产' from a single financial report."""
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2019年Q1', '2020年末', '2021年3月31日'")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is '期末余额' or '期初余额' / '年末' / '季度末'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount in yuan")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="Which year's financial report this is from, e.g. '2019年第一季度'")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Any reason given for change, e.g. '预付购买固定资产款项增加'")
    change_percent: str | None = Field(description="Any reported change percentage, e.g. '增长34.91%'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_non_current_asset_records: list[OtherNonCurrentAssetRecord]
